The claim appears to be saying that the events depicted in a Shakespearean problem play occurred chronologically before a geological/astronomical scarp was imaged. However, this comparison is problematic: - The play depicts fictional events set in a specific time period (the play's setting) - The scarp is a physical feature that exists on Titania (a moon of Uranus) - The scarp was "first imaged" in 1986, but the scarp itself existed long before that - The claim seems to conflate when the play was written/performed with when the scarp was imaged
